note: ONE freshness limit for monthly Fed series (M2SL etc.), supervisor ruling 15 Oct: age in days from the month start (last_date = YYYY-MM-01) <= monthly_days is fresh. Read by index.html (inlined as FRESHNESS; tests/tfresh.js asserts equality), scripts/runs_log.py (_runs.json) and tests/tsmoke.js.

signal_cards.note: ONE limit for stale labels AND data confidence (supervisor 15 Oct): a card is fresh while its last point is within the limit (full confidence), past it the card is stale (no score, no confidence, out of POST NOW). daily: last closed UTC day minus daily_lag_days (one-day step-back); weekly (wrsi): minus weekly_lag_days; settled funding: funding_h hours (= _runs.json funding lim_h).

market_note: market.json (breadth, dominance, TOTAL2/3) freshness limit in hours. 21 Oct supervisor ruling: 3h, the same as OI/basis, with the hourly :17 data job. Read by index.html (inlined FRESHNESS -> DLIM.market) and scripts/runs_log.py (_runs.json market.limit_h, which data_age.py / the stale alarm read).
derivs_hourly_note: ONE limit for open interest and basis (supervisor 24 Oct): age measured from the newest stored hour's START; hourly :17 job stores an OI hour only once start+2h <= fetch, so a fresh write is 2h17m old and one missed run reaches 4h17m (fresh); past 5h is stale. Read by index.html (DVLIM), scripts/runs_log.py (LIM), ops/netlify/kick.mjs (backup threshold) and tests/tlim5.js.
h10_note: Fed H.10 daily FX (DEXUSEU, DEXJPUS, DEXCHUS, DTWEXBGS) freshness limit in days from last_date, age <= limit ok. H.10 publishes weekly, Monday ~21:15 UTC, through the prior Friday (Tuesday after a Monday holiday), and the daily macro batch picks it up at 00:20 UTC, so a Friday value is normally ~11.0 days old when it is replaced and ~12.0 days after a holiday Monday. 9 Nov supervisor ruling: keep FRED, widen 10 -> 14 days. Read by index.html (inlined FRESHNESS), scripts/runs_log.py (_runs.json macro, which the stale alarm reads) and tests/tsmoke.js.
